name: Beckey Route (Southwest Face)
approach: From the Blue Lake Trailhead (FS Trail #314, ~5,400 ft, on SR-20 about 1 mile west of Washington Pass), follow the maintained, well-graded Blue Lake Trail north through forest and open meadow for about 1.5 miles to a small meadow just past a small stream crossing (the last reliable water). Leave the maintained trail here on a climbers' boot path heading left/north, ascending through granite slabs, talus, and heather meadow toward the gully that drops from the notch between Liberty Bell and Concord Tower. The path is steep in places with short sections of 3rd-class scrambling. At a fork roughly 200 ft below the notch, stay left to reach the Liberty Bell-Concord Tower notch (~7,300 ft) — about 2 miles and ~2,100 ft of gain total from the car, 1.5-2.5 hours. The approach gully commonly holds snow into late June, so carry an ice axe (and possibly crampons) for an early-season ascent.
